parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) A student does this experiment using a set of three identical resistors. Her results show that, within the limits of experimental accuracy, the combined resistance of two identical resistors connected in series is four times the combined resistance of the same two resistors connected in parallel. To test whether her results are true for other values of resistance, she does the same procedure with other sets of three identical resistors. Suggest the values of resistance she could use to reach a conclusion during a 1 hour practical lesson. ................................................................................................................................................... ................................................................................................................................................... .............................................................................................................................................
